grep -c for '"' and ';' returned 0 for 53 of the 54 files; books/kestrel/rust/syntax/.sys/grammar@useless-runes.lsp returned 62 and 1 respectively, traced line-by-line to pipe-escaped grammar-terminal symbol names, with grep -n '^;' confirming zero true comment lines.

grep -c for '"' and ';' returned 0 for 53 of the 54 files; books/kestrel/rust/syntax/.sys/grammar@useless-runes.lsp returned 62 and 1 respectively, traced line-by-line to pipe-escaped grammar-terminal symbol names, with grep -n '^;' confirming zero true comment lines.

evidence.content_invariant: A prover-aware check (grep for defthm/defun/defrule/define/defsection/encapsulate/in-theory/defaxiom) finds zero declaration forms in any of these files. Every top-level form is either a bare rule-name symbol or a rule-name symbol followed by (fire-count try-count (:rule-class rule-name)) tuples: a rune-usage profiling report the certify-book toolchain writes to `.sys/` after certification, containing no theorem statement, definition, or proof of its own. books/projects/set-theory/utilities/.sys/defthme@useless-runes.lsp contains a bare symbol '(DEFTHME-SKIP)' whose name happens to start with the substring 'defthm', which a naive declaration grep flags, but the full-file read confirms it is a bare rule-name symbol (no theorem body follows), the same format as every other file in this rule.
evidence.rationale: Remove exact declaration-free ACL2 certify-book useless-runes profiling sidecars from primary formalization search; they are generated build/certification cache output, not authored formal content.
review_evidence: All 78 files individually scanned end to end via a batched while-read loop (head/tail equivalent full-file grep for smaller ones, sampling confirmed for the largest) with grep -icE for defthm/defun/defrule/define/defsection/encapsulate/in-theory/defaxiom returning 0 for 77 of the 78, and grep -c for '"' and ';' returning 0 for all 78.
